capabilities: Chat with AI about the current note or workspace
Review and accept or dismiss AI suggestions
Manage todos and background AI operations
Format and preview writing layouts for export
disambiguation: Not a media streaming tool; it is a note capture stream with an AI copilot.
extras: Desktop only; mobile is not supported. AI is optional, and capture/browsing work without it. Credentials are stored in the plugin's data.json; optional plaintext backup is off by default.
problem: Obsidian lacks a built-in running stream for quick capture, AI-assisted note review, and todo management in one place.
summary: Personal note stream and AI copilot that captures thoughts, chats about notes, reviews suggestions, manages todos, and prepares writing layouts.
